# Public observed LinkedIn login subtree

Source: https://www.linkedin.com/login/, observed 2026-09-15, Polish, viewport 1146×483. Recovered byte-for-byte from the existing local form corpus `linkedin-login-2026-09-15/page.html` and `page.css`; this is not a fresh capture. The specimen includes `#workspace`, native controls and responsive duplicate layouts. Public computed presentation is retained. Input values, resources, handlers, iframe contents, SVG paths and the surrounding page shell were omitted by the original isolated Playwright capture.

The replay uses only synthetic credentials on an intercepted `.test` origin. Its click/Enter handlers and post-submission transitions are synthetic mechanics. No successful production authentication or submission is claimed.
